findings: All four degree constraints and no-A–C-edge convention match; counting paths is not counting reached vertices.
The largest universally forced z equals the infimum of graph maxima; this equivalence does not presume an extremizing graph.
Theorem 2.3 concerns phi only; the adjacent remark leaves the psi analogue without a result or counterexample at that time.
Theorem 12.2 only treats equality at x, not general symmetry.
The matrix and positive weights are prior work and reproduced correctly. The present proof verifies them directly and does not import weighted LP duality or a source extremizer.
